top_signals.title: Venezuela, TotalEnergies Pave Way for Oil Company’s Return
top_signals.summary: Venezuela and TotalEnergies SE signed a memorandum of understanding on Saturday, setting up the French company for a return to operations in the South American country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Canada’s observer role in fighter program raises export hopes
top_signals.summary: Canada is weighing purchases of the aircraft, while the partner countries seeks a wider export market and more cooperation among like-minded nations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
